categories.main_business_segments: LB Group primarily operates in the production and sales of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment, sponge titanium, zirconium products, and lithium battery cathode and anode materials. The company is a global leader in titanium dioxide and sponge titanium production, with significant capacity in both sulfuric acid and chloride process titanium dioxide. It also engages in mining and processing of titanium minerals and related chemical products, as well as new energy materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced sulfuric acid and chloride processes for titanium dioxide production, with chloride process technology being more energy-efficient and environmentally friendly. It uses large-scale continuous production methods and has proprietary technologies in molten salt chlorination, titanium sponge reduction, and synthetic rutile production. The company also integrates green and circular economy models, utilizing by-products and waste recycling to reduce costs and environmental impact. In lithium battery materials, it uses solid-phase and liquid-phase synthesis for cathode materials and advanced graphitization techniques for anode materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: LB Group serves a diverse customer base across coatings, plastics, paper, printing inks, rubber, aerospace, biomedical, chemical metallurgy, marine engineering, and new energy sectors. Its titanium dioxide products are widely used in paints, plastics, and paper industries globally. The lithium battery materials cater to electric vehicles and energy storage markets. The company exports to over 110 countries and regions across six continents, with significant sales in Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Henan, Sichuan, Hubei, Yunnan, Gansu, and other provinces. It has established subsidiaries and sales offices in Hong Kong, Europe, and the Americas to support its international market expansion. Its products are sold worldwide, covering Asia, Europe, Africa, North and South America, and Oceania.
categories.supply_chain_position: LB Group operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream mining and processing of titanium minerals, midstream production of titanium dioxide and sponge titanium, and downstream sales of titanium products and lithium battery materials. It controls raw material extraction, intermediate processing, and final product manufacturing, positioning itself as a full-chain operator in the titanium industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in titanium dioxide production technologies, especially advancing chloride process capacity and product quality. It invests heavily in R&D for high-performance titanium products, green manufacturing, and resource recycling technologies. LB Group is also expanding into new energy materials, developing lithium iron phosphate cathode and graphite anode materials with proprietary technologies. Digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing are key strategic priorities to enhance operational efficiency and product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: LB Group generates revenue primarily through the sale of titanium dioxide pigments, sponge titanium, zirconium products, and lithium battery materials. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales and distribution channels, with a significant portion of revenue from exports. The company also earns income from by-product sales and government subsidies related to technology and environmental initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: LB Group is a global leader in the titanium dioxide and sponge titanium markets, ranking first worldwide in production capacity for these products. It competes with major international and domestic producers in the titanium and chemical materials sectors. The company differentiates itself through its integrated supply chain, advanced technologies, and strong R&D capabilities, maintaining a leading position in both cost and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, LB Group reported revenues of approximately RMB 27.5 billion, representing a 2.8% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.17 billion, reflecting a decline due to pricing pressures and increased costs. The company has a total asset base exceeding RMB 66 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technological upgrades. Despite short-term profit fluctuations, LB Group maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by its market leadership and diversified product portfolio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LB Group emphasizes its full industry chain integration, combining upstream resource control with advanced production technologies to offer high-quality, cost-competitive titanium products. Its proprietary chloride process technology and green manufacturing practices provide environmental and efficiency advantages. The company’s global brand recognition, extensive product range, and customized technical support create strong customer value and competitive differentiation in both domestic and international markets.
